description: Per-domain, per-objective mapping guidance for CSA CCMv4. Gives the framework-mapping phase a focused, per-domain context: what each objective actually requires (intent), whether it is mappable for a platform/infrastructure service, and which mechanism classes may or must never satisfy it. allow_mechanisms / deny_mechanisms reference mechanism_classes ids. Consumed by map-framework-mapping (fan-out), validate_domain_applicability.py, and validate_domain_mapping_accuracy.py.

transit_encryption.description: Encryption-in-transit / TLS controls (e.g. enforce or detect TLS on a data channel).

at_rest_encryption.description: Encryption-at-rest controls using service-side KMS keys or client-side attribute encryption.

key_lifecycle.description: Cryptographic key lifecycle controls (generation, rotation, revocation, destruction, inventory).

access_control.description: Identity/authorization controls: IAM identity policy, principal scoping, resource-based policy, sharing, least-privilege.

network_isolation.description: Network-isolation controls: VPC, subnet, security group, segmentation, private endpoint.

resilience.description: Availability / resilience controls: multi-AZ placement, redundancy, failover, recovery.

access_event_logging.description: Controls that LOG access / invocation / activity events (who accessed what), e.g. CloudTrail data/management events.

misconfig_detection.description: Detective controls that flag resource MISCONFIGURATION / posture / drift (not access logging).

tagging_classification.description: Tag-based controls that classify or label a resource (not the sensitivity of data inside it).

vulnerability_management.description: Vulnerability scanning, patching, malware, CVE, Inspector pairing.

supply_chain.description: Software supply-chain / artifact-integrity controls: code signing, signature verification, trusted-publisher enforcement of deployment artifacts.

capacity_monitoring.description: Controls measuring resource capacity or consumption for capacity planning; does not imply failover or disaster recovery.

secrets_management.description: Controls that keep application secrets in a managed secrets store instead of plaintext application configuration.

system_event_logging.description: Controls defining application/system log collection. Does not imply identity/access audit records or security alerting.

domains.intent: Governs logging and monitoring. Controls that record access/activity events and protect logs satisfy the technical objectives; some objectives concern the logging service rather than the target resource.

objectives.title: Log Protection

serverless_compute.na_reason: Serverless compute owns no audit-log store to protect; the log store (CloudWatch Logs group, CloudTrail trail, S3 log bucket) is a separate service's resource. Log-store protection is N/A here.

objectives.intent: Requires reporting failures and anomalies; detective controls that surface anomalies in the resource implement it.
